name: Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship
benefit:
1. Hostel students receive a subsistence allowance of ₹1,200 per month.
1. Non-hostel residents are provided with a subsistence allowance of ₹650 per month.

> **Reimbursement of mandatory and non-refundable fees.**
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant Should be studying in graduate/post-graduate courses.
1. The maximum annual income of the guardian should be ₹2,50,00/- for post-matric and ₹6,00,000/- for top class.
1. The applicant has 40 percent or more disability.
